propositions: The idempotency oracle patches _now_iso only on binding_store, but RP-02 S2 T2 moved clear_absent and sibling operations to binding_lifecycle which resolves its own module-level _now_iso, causing the patch to no longer reach those operations.

The integration test still passes because the no-churn contract means the clock is never consulted on a healthy pass, but its ability to catch regressions in moved operations (unconditional timestamp stamping) is silently weakened.

The clear_absent operation is structurally unreachable on a healthy in-window pass because both call sites are gated on out-of-window-but-alive keys, making mutation-driven RED verification of AC#2 impossible at the integration tier.
Unit-tier coverage of the no-stamp contract for clear_absent exists in test_binding_lifecycle.py::test_clear_absent_does_not_dirty_an_entry_with_no_absence, containing the risk to that operation.
Gerrit change 1911 (commit dc2e799bd3) delivers AC#1 and AC#4 by patching _now_iso on both binding_store and binding_lifecycle modules.
